card.sourceText:
an unreleased Claude model found 62 Chrome bugs, all critical or high, 13 of them sandbox escapes. it chained four into a one-click attack: open a page on a Mac and attacker code runs outside the sandbox. all fixed in Chrome 156. updated yet?

https://t.co/MdbKRKsMiw https://t.co/EtashqrAek

behavior.reasonToExist: The CVE count measures output, not capability; failed attempts per working chain is the missing denominator for judging the model claim.
